dedupe_keys.name: rico dataset multivariate hvac indoor and outdoor time series from the sintef zeb test cell

description: RICO is an open dataset of transitory heating and cooling regimes measured in the Zero Energy Building (ZEB) Test Cell laboratory of SINTEF in Trondheim, Norway, built to train and test machine learning models for indoor temperature forecasting and HVAC control, and described in Data in Brief in 2025. It holds 305 multivariate time series, each four hours long with 80 features, from internal sensors of temperature, humidity and radiation and from the building's weather station, recorded at ten samples per minute and normalised to one-minute intervals over five acquisition phases lasting from a few days to 17 days across eleven months; each HDF file joins sensor data with acquisition metadata. The authors note that such data are costly to obtain because the building must be driven beyond normal operating ranges. Coverage: one test cell in Trondheim. Access: free download from Zenodo (DOI 10.60609/tw79-4k72 through data.sintef.no). Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a controlled test cell, not an occupied building. Simulation uses: training and validating indoor temperature and HVAC control models, including model predictive control. Related records: the Google Smart Buildings dataset and AlphaBuilding.
